code.cohort_scope: within CODE, previously examined source; no confirmation claim
code.labels: explicit publisher flags, unrecognized values masked; no clinical adjudication claim

waveform.window_policy: short: entire 2934 samples; long: center 4000 observed samples; other patterns excluded
waveform.temporal_mask: remove invalid suffix before convolution, length-bucket forward; no synthetic padding enters model
waveform.unknown_amplitude_units: use native amplitude; do not infer individual acquisition gain from HDF5

training.selection: validation macro AP first; non-finite loss aborts; calibration never used to fit weights; no test metrics for selection
training.deep_gate: Run one full-regularized seed if partial fails +0.03 validation macro-F1 against frozen on identical patient rows, or if verified cross-source forgetting motivates it. No retries for performance.
training.repeat_rule: repeat frozen and best eligible non-frozen variant on the other two seeds; disclose all completed variants and failures

calibration.thresholds: per endpoint fit on calibration only, from 0.05 to 0.95 in 0.01 steps; maximize F1 subject to sensitivity >=0.50 for AFIB/RBBB/1AVB; if infeasible choose highest sensitivity and record

source_policy.chapman_cpsc: verify authorized signal and patient manifests before supervised development; known historical exposure; unsupported labels masked
source_policy.mimic: approved waveform subset and train patients only; no reports or inferred negatives; no confirmatory use
source_policy.heedb: no acquisition without explicit credentials, DUA and CEDIA authorization; physician labels must be audited before any test
source_policy.p4: separate eligibility required; do not map history or nonspecific abnormalities to current ECG endpoints
